newsitem.title: SPAIN: Businessman shot, wounded in Spain Basque region.
newsitem.headline: Businessman shot, wounded in Spain Basque region.

text.p: An unidentified gunman shot and wounded a local businessman in Spain's Basque country on Tuesday, Basque police said.

The attack in the town of Tolosa came one day after a Supreme Court judge was shot dead in Madrid and a car bomb killed an employee of a military base in Granada. The government blamed both attacks on the Basque separatist group ETA.
